Excellent eatery with wonderful waitstaff!
Mar 2025 • Family
Such a lovely, charming place! We loved all the waitstaff, especially the sweet, helpful young waitress at our table. We ordered phở bò (which came in a boiling pot of broth and we added noodles, raw slices of beef, onions and other items to the hot broth to cook), beef bò lúc lắc with fries, and egg noodles with seafood. Everything was so delicious! Also had red sangria and a very tasty, unique jasmine calamansi ice tea for drinks. Highly recommend.
